items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Another guy. Bill Conley. What did they play? All drummers, I wanted to call them.

ctx.x: Yeah. And how did you get into it?

Well, uh... Well, I... I was about nineteen... What happened? Well, I was born. Mm-hmm. And my daddy bought a piano, you see. And, uh, I was always interested in music. So I started to practice around the house on the piano. And finally, I began to be more interested in it. So I flew around and started playing little house chords. And then I improved on it. And then I started playing little house chords. I took the book, book cards. There were a lot of these drummers out that time. And then I was called the work…
